text_block_list.text:
When I headed over to the classroom to 
have a meeting with Mayano Top Gun...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, Maya knows way more than you, so 
there!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... "What's up" is my line! You went 
and got popular while I wasn't looking~.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Just now, when I said, "Trainer-chan is an 
adult, so their way of teaching is so 
smart!"...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Speaking of which! I saw you carefully 
maintaining Maya-chan's gear the other 
day, and I thought it was so wonderful!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya always thinks so too! That 
Trainer-chan is super wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Because, you know, being with you, 
Trainer... makes both the races and 
academy life suuuper fun!
choice_data_list: I'm glad to hear you say that.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
But... Maya doesn't like that! Everyone 
knows about cool places that I don't know 
yet—!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I told them stuff that nooo one knew 
about! Like this and that, and so on and 
so forth~~

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehe☆ Everyone was super surprised, going 
"Kyaa! No way!?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
A se-cret♪ That's what you get for being 
so popular~!

Knowing that she was satisfied with the 
guidance brought relief, but I couldn't 
help wondering what they had talked about.
